items.title: A 10-year-old CNN outperforms frontier LLMs for skin cancer diagnosis
items.summary: Recent research demonstrates that a convolutional neural network (CNN) developed a decade ago surpasses contemporary large language models (LLMs) in diagnosing skin cancer. This finding highlights the potential of established AI techniques in critical healthcare applications, urging developers to consider the robustness of older models.

items.title: Cerebras Deploys Trillion-Parameter AI Models
items.summary: Cerebras has successfully deployed AI models with a staggering trillion parameters, pushing the boundaries of what is possible in AI model complexity and performance. This advancement is significant for developers working on large-scale AI applications, as it opens new avenues for research and deployment.

items.title: I refuse to accept a censored Internet. Join Me at FOSDEM 27
items.summary: A call to action for developers and engineers to advocate for an uncensored Internet at the upcoming FOSDEM 27 conference. This initiative emphasizes the importance of open-source principles and freedom of information in technology, encouraging participation in shaping the future of the web.

items.title: AI use leads UC Berkeley math professor to see 'no point' in grading homework
items.summary: A UC Berkeley math professor has decided to stop grading homework due to the pervasive use of AI tools by students. This decision raises important discussions about the role of AI in education and its implications for assessment practices, which developers in educational technology should consider.

items.title: JetBrains Thinkrail
items.summary: JetBrains has launched Thinkrail, a new tool designed to streamline the development process for web engineers. This tool aims to enhance productivity and collaboration among developers, making it a noteworthy addition to the web development ecosystem.
